svg.title: RTMSF deployment on AWS
svg.desc: S3 sends object creation and deletion notifications to a Standard SQS queue. An ECS Fargate task runs the cloud-neutral routing, WOERA, and PMCP components through AWS adapters. Routing loads table definitions from Glue. PMCP reads and changes Glue partitions and performs S3 HEAD or bounded LIST checks. The worker renews and acknowledges SQS messages, sends terminal failures to a separate queue, and writes CloudWatch logs. ECR supplies the container image and an IAM task role grants access. All service and resource symbols are official AWS architecture icons from the July 31, 2026 package. ECS and Fargate are shown with separate official icons.
svg.text: AWS adapters connect cloud services to the cloud-neutral synchronization core.
Existing VPC / public subnet · outbound HTTPS
Match object path to configured table
Group events by partition within Q / T_max
Register or remove a partition as needed
RTMSF — Real-Time Metadata Synchronization Framework · Official AWS architecture icons
